dedupe_keys.name: hdsvt high density semantic vehicle trajectory dataset based on a cosmopolitan city bridge

description: HDSVT: High-Density Semantic Vehicle Trajectory Dataset Based on a Cosmopolitan City Bridge is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Di Wen et al. Trajectory prediction is used in autonomous driving and requires models supported by datasets. Most existing vehicle trajectory datasets often lack long-duration trajectories or high vehicle density, limiting their use in complex scenarios. In this paper, we construct a High-Density Semantic Vehicle Trajectory Dataset (HDSVT), collected via Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) over the Guangzhou Bridge. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2025. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 105147683550 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
